verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own custom Dashboards, built from widgets that each visualize one or more datasets across multiple projects, so the core of building dashboards is delivered. The evidence does not show visualization types, template variables or sharing. missing for 10: documented range of visualization/chart types, template variables or dashboard-level filter variables, sharing or permission controls for dashboards, dashboards-as-code definitions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: Dashboards are made up of one or more widgets, and each widget visualizes one or more dataset.

Sentry's [Dashboards](https://sentry.io/orgredirect/organizations/:orgslug/dashboards/) provide you with a broad overview of your application’s health by allowing you to navigate through error and performance data across multiple projects.
